## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been carrying it for so long. Before you make a final decision tomorrow, could we talk tonight or take a little time to think through your options? If the job is harming your health, leaving may absolutely be the right choice—but you don’t have to decide in the middle of the worst moment. We can look at practical things together, like finances, notice periods, time off, or whether another job is lined up. Whatever you choose, I’m here with you.

## 2

I understand why some images or institutions might feel difficult to trust, but the evidence for a spherical Earth doesn’t depend on space photographs alone. People have observed ships disappearing hull-first over the horizon, measured Earth’s curved shadow during lunar eclipses, and used different stars and shadow angles in different locations to calculate its size. Modern navigation, satellite communication, time zones, and flights also work because Earth is a globe. Photos from space are one kind of evidence, but they’re supported by many independent observations anyone can investigate.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors mixed together. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny gas molecules. The shorter-colored waves, especially blue, get scattered in all directions more strongly than the longer red and orange waves. So when you look across the sky, blue light is arriving at your eyes from lots of directions.

At sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere. Much of the blue gets scattered away before the light reaches us, leaving more red, orange, and pink light. Space looks black because there is no atmosphere there to scatter sunlight around.

## 4

雨落在深夜的城市里，像无数细小的手指，轻轻敲打着窗玻璃。街灯被水汽晕开，昏黄的光铺在湿漉漉的路面上，映出摇曳的树影。远处偶尔驶过一辆汽车，轮胎卷起白亮的水花，很快又消失在雨幕中。屋檐下的风铃不再清脆，只发出低低的碰撞声。房间里，一盏台灯安静地亮着，热茶冒出的雾气模糊了窗外的世界。这样的夜晚仿佛把城市藏了起来，也让人的心慢慢安静下来。
